senses.gloss: to split, crack or squeeze open; to wound.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 93a:9">B. Kam. 93ᵃ</cite> <he>הכני פְּצָעֵנִי על מנת לפטור פטור</he> (if one said to one’s neighbor) strike me, wound me, with the condition that thou be free (from indemnity): he is free.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 93a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>הכני פצעני על מנת לפטור וכ׳</he> (if he said) ‘strike me, wound me’, (and he is aked,) with the condition that I shall be free?, and he answers, yes.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> <he>הפּוֹצֵעַ שני חוטין</he> he who divides off two threads (on the loom).

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:21">Tosef. ib. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:21">IX</cite>), 21 <he>כדי לִפְצוֹעַ וכ׳</he> large enough to divide with it two threads (on each side) at a time.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 38:5">Yalk. Gen. 38</cite> <he>פְּצַעְתִּיו</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01441"><he>פֶּצַע</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 75a:5">Sabb. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>הצד חלזון והפּוֹצְעוֹ</he> he who catches a snail and breaks it open (squeezes it out); <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:2">Tosef. ib. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:2">IX</cite>), 2 <he>לפצעו</he> (corr. acc.). Sabb. l. c. <he>שפְּצָעוֹ מת</he> when he squeezed it out after it was dead. Y. ib. XVII, beg. 16ᵃ <he>לִפְצוֹעַ בו אגוזים</he> to open nuts with it.

<cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 1:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. I, 6</cite> <he>פּוֹצְעִין את מוחו וכ׳</he> (not <he>פצעין</he>), v. <cite ref="C00576"><he>גֶּזֶר</he></cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>פָּצוּעַ</he>; pl. <he>פְּצוּעִים</he>, <he>פְּצוּעִין</he>. Teb. Yom III, 6 <he>זיתים פ׳</he> burst olives.
Ter. X, 7 פְּצוּעֵי תרומה burst olives set aside for priests’ gifts; a. e.—Esp. פְּצוּעַ דַּכָּא (פְּ׳ דַּכָּה) one whose testicles are crushed (forbidden to marry, Deut. XXIII, 2).
Ib. 2 איזה פ׳ ד׳ כל שנִפְצְעוּ וכ׳ what is meant by p’tsuʿa dakka? One whose testicles, one or both, are crushed.
<cite ref="Yevamot 75b:2">Ib. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ ד׳ בידי שמים כשר</he> one whose testicles are crushed from a natural cause (not through human action) is permitted to marry.

Ib. (ref. to Deut. l. c.) היינו דקרינן פְּצוּעַ ולא קרינן פְּצִיעַ Ar. it is therefore (to indicate human action) that the text has p’tsuʿa, (one that has been mashed) and not p’tsiʿa (one who is mashed); [ed. פצוע … הַפָּצוּעַ …, v. Rashi]. Ib. פ׳ בכולן the expression ‘mashed’ refers to all parts of the genitals.

senses.gloss: to divide the ends of a web, fringe.
units: <cite ref="Menachot 40b:8">Men. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון שפָּצְעוּ בה שלשה</he> (Ms. M. <he>שצבעו</he>, Mss. R. a. K. <he>שבצעו</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) as soon as they had fringed three fingers’ lengths of it.

senses.gloss: same. Y. Maasr. I, end, 49ᵇ זית שפִּיצְּעוּ וכ׳ olives which they opened with unclean hands; Tosef. Toh. X, 11 שפצעו; Sabb. 145ᵃ המְפַצֵּעַ בזתיס וכ׳; a. e.; v. infra Hif
to be split, squeezed open, crushed; to be wounded. Y. Taan. I, 63ᵈ top נ׳ בנו his son was wounded (or had a fracture). Yeb. l. c.; a. e.—
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:2">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 23:29">Prov. XXIII, 29</cite>) <he>זו הזונה … נִפְצַעַת וכ׳</he> that is the adulteress who is wounded with wounds of love, ‘for naught’, without any wound through her husband.
<cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 3:8">Orl. III, 8</cite> <he>נִתְפַּצְּעוּ האגוזים</he> if the nuts (in the mixture) were cracked; <cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 5:10">Tosef. Ter. V, 10</cite>.

senses.gloss: to split. Y. Shek. VI, beg. 49ᶜ מַפְצִיעַ עצים splitting wood.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 9:6">Snh. IX, 6</cite> <he>מַפְצִיעִין את מוחו וכ׳</he>; Y. ib. X, 28ᵈ bot. <he>ומְפַצְּעִין וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="C00576"><he>גֶּזֶר</he></cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Yoma 28b:14">Yoma 28ᵇ</cite> <he>תימור של חמה מַפְצִיעַ לכאן ולכאן</he> the light-column of the dawn irradiates in all directions, opp. to <he>מתמר ועולה כמקל</he>, v. <cite ref="V00703"><he>תָּמַר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 38a:10">Ib. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>של הללו מפציע וכ׳</he> the smoke column of the frankincense prepared by them branched off in all directions.
